title: localfix: send application/mimi-protocol Content-Type
description: mimi-protocol PR #171 (2026-10-21) proposes application/mimi-protocol for TLS-encoded request/response bodies (not the JSON directory, not the proxyDownload response). mimid sends application/octet-stream (crates/mimid-server/src/http.rs:58 PROTOCOL_CONTENT_TYPE).
